name: Nuevo Laredo

queries.query: Nuevo Laredo Tamaulipas cadastral parcels GIS land registry official
queries.result: First-party results identified the Nuevo Laredo municipal government, the Tamaulipas Instituto Registral y Catastral, and official state cadastral/cartographic references. No public parcel feature service or geometry download was found.

queries.query: Nuevo Laredo Tamaulipas catastro mapa parcelario sitio oficial
queries.result: La búsqueda en fuentes oficiales confirmó el Instituto Registral y Catastral estatal, referencias oficiales a cartografía catastral municipal y el portal municipal de Consulta y Pago Predial; no expuso un visor parcelario público ni una respuesta anónima de geometría con identificador nativo seguro.

officialAndRelevantLeads.operator: Gobierno de Nuevo Laredo; municipal government
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: The official municipal site links Consulta y Pago Predial. Its current JavaScript identifies the public service base https://nld.gob.mx/predial_ws/Predial and the predial route requires a cadastral account key; no parcel geometry layer is advertised.

officialAndRelevantLeads.operator: Instituto Registral y Catastral del Estado de Tamaulipas
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: The state institute says it integrates the state's real-estate inventory and supports consultation of current and historical digital cartography for urban and rural properties, in support of municipalities. This evidences a cadastral custodian, not an open parcel API.

officialAndRelevantLeads.operator: Periódico Oficial del Estado de Tamaulipas / municipal Nuevo Laredo catastro regulation
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: The official regulation describes municipal cadastral block plans and their required parcel/lot content, but provides no machine-readable layer, safe parcel identifiers, or public service endpoint.

The official 2026 valuation decree explicitly covers urban, suburban, ejidal-origin population-center, locality, and rural properties in Nuevo Laredo; it is cadastral/valuation evidence only and contains no parcel geometry service.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.method: GET; official HTML and linked JavaScript inspection
requestsAndEndpointChecks.summary: Current site assets were inspected. The site exposes the /predial route and its JavaScript names the public predial service base https://nld.gob.mx/predial_ws/Predial. No map, WMS, WFS, ArcGIS, GeoServer, parcel, schema, CRS, or geometry route was exposed.
The municipal predial page was blocked to the anonymous request. This was recorded as a UI/request limitation, not evidence of citywide parcel absence.
Public predial advertising metadata returned. It contains image paths only; no parcel identifiers or geometry.

Public predial display/status response returned. It exposed service status metadata only; no parcel identifiers, geometry, schema, or CRS. The account consultation route was not queried because it is cadastral-account oriented and could expose unsafe property fields.
Official state institute page read; its cartography and registry mandate was recorded. No anonymous parcel viewer/API link was exposed.
Official open-data index read. It lists a municipal Nuevo Laredo geographic-location PDF and registry-office addresses, but no parcel layer or geometry endpoint.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Municipal predial/catastro services and state registral-cadastral cartography custodian are evidenced.

qualityAssessment.identityReadiness: not ready; no safe native parcel feature response was retrieved
qualityAssessment.attributesRequested: none beyond public service/schema discovery; no owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax, account, or personal fields requested
safeFieldAllowlist: native parcel identifier if publicly exposed

blocker: No anonymous first-party parcel viewer, API, schema/CRS response, or geometry-only extract was verified after bounded English and Spanish discovery.
remainingUncertainty: Municipal and state cadastral cartography may be available through an offline/request procedure or an unlinked authenticated/internal viewer. Search failure, the 403 predial page, and lack of an exact-point hit do not establish citywide absence.
nextStep: On a later attempt, locate a documented public Nuevo Laredo or Tamaulipas cadastral viewer/API, inspect its current JavaScript/configuration, and request only a small anonymous geometry-plus-native-ID response before considering adapter qualification.
registryBasis: The municipal government exposes a predial service, the official municipal catastro regulation describes cadastral plans, and the state Instituto Registral y Catastral explicitly maintains and supports consultation of current and historical urban/rural cadastral cartography.
identityPolicy: No GeoJSON retained because no safe native parcel identity and geometry response was verified.
